text: Ko haanunoo ko nde fefindiiɓe ɓen e dow Yumma gomɗinɓe ɓen Aa'isa yo Alla weltor mo addaynoo seedeeɓe nayo e dow ngol fefindagol maɓɓe mawngol, ɓe seedoo e dow sellugol ko ɓe dammbi kon e makko, si tawii ɓe addaali seedeeɓe nayo e dow ɗum -te ɓe addataa ɓe poomaa- haray kamɓe ko ɓe fenooɓe ka Ñaawoore Alla.
